notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Transfer view, not a funnel. NQ #64 (the live bot's S2) run unchanged on ES. It was picked on NQ only, so ES 2018–2024 is out-of-sample for the choice. The ES holdout was not touched. Across all 210 NQ survivors run on ES, 86% were profitable in 2018–2022 but only 17% in 2023–2024 (median Sharpe −0.58), so the effect did not carry over to ES.
notes.holdout: First open-sweep look at the ES holdout, but not an untouched one. No open-sweep strategy had been scored on 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of these same frozen picks), and only these were run, so there's no selection among holdout results. But they were picked after seeing 2023–2024, and other strategy families had already been scored on ES 2025+ (see their data-access ledgers).
notes.all: Out-of-sample for ES. #64 was chosen on NQ only, so no ES data was used to pick it. It made money on ES in 2018–2022 but lost in both validation years (2023–2024). Switch to Validation to see the breakdown.

legs.settings_text: 1m bars, overnight (18:00–09:30) range, high or low, whichever triggers first: within 15 min of 09:30 a break by more than 0.05 dATR, then 3 straight close(s) beyond it → trade with the break; stop 0.1 dATR, no target, out by 16:00 ET, flat every night
